answer: An identity earns its seat through origin attestation from a trusted capture device, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 629 pays 10064 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. Trust the plume of the check, count the haven of the cost, and read the zenith of the history before any answer is graded. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
